newsitem.title: USA: Hughes Electronics names Noski vice chairman.
newsitem.headline: Hughes Electronics names Noski vice chairman.

text.p: Hughes Electronics Corp said it has named Chief Financial Officer Charles Noski to the additional post of vice chairman.

He will continue to report to Chairman and Chief Executive Officer Michael Armstrong, and Michael Smith also will continue to serve as a vice chairman of Hughes Electronics in addition to his duties as chairman of unit Hughes Aircraft Co.

Noski joined Hughes in 1990 as vice president and controller after a career with accounting firm Deloitte & Touche. He was named chief financial officer and a member of the board at Hughes Electronics in 1992.
